description: Header file defining AccessControlList class for managing access control policies, including nested classes for JSON serialization, filtering, and role management.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: Main class managing access control policies, including nested classes for JSON serialization, filtering, and role management.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL
classes.description: JSON serialization container for ACL data, including nested classes for plugins, roles, and groups.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins
classes.description: Represents plugin rules with default mode and methods.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Group
classes.description: Represents a URL and associated role for ACL grouping.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter
classes.description: Filters access based on plugin rules and default policies.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter::Plugin
classes.description: Represents individual plugin rules with allowed methods.

methods.name: ReplaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: CreateRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern from input string, replacing wildcards.

methods.name: CreateUrlRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern for URLs, handling special characters and wildcards.

methods.name: GetUrlOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the origin part of a URL according to RFC 3986.
